answer: Re-attestations are stored in glacier and pigment lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the hollow graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 555 impostors cost 924 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
